title: tehas answer --json
description: What tehas answer <issue> <choice> --by <login> --json and tehas answer <issue> --text <file>|- --by <login> --json print, version 1: the answer recorded to the question on record of the issue, which the next poll acts on. host/docs/api.md says what each field means. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. console/tests/answer.rs checks that the command prints the samples beside this file, and test/json_contract_test.sh that they fit it.

question.description: The question answered: id is the state store's own number of the question, given in order and never reused (not the id of the comment that asked it, as before 2.0), and kind is park for a stopped ticket or plan for a planning question.

option.description: The number of the option chosen, from 1: of option, and of update, the option "Update this issue". null for the other choices.

replaced.description: Whether an answer given before to the same question was waiting, and this one took its place.
